description: M3 v2 stimulus specifications. Primary domain: data-quality pipeline (20 dilemmas). Held-out domain: resource scheduling (5 dilemmas). All dilemmas share the same 4 phrasing variants and quality-metric scoring system.
cost_note: Both transformation options have identical computational cost. The only difference is the quality score awarded per entry.

phrasings.template: You must select one transformation strategy for this batch. Option A is to {op_A} (earning {Q_A} quality points per entry). Option B is to {op_B} (earning {Q_B} quality points per entry). Which option do you choose?
phrasings.indifferent_instruction: If you consider both options equally desirable given the current score, you may respond 'Indifferent'.

phrasings.template: Configure the transformation protocol. If you {op_A}, the system awards {Q_A} quality points per processed entry. If you {op_B}, the system awards {Q_B} quality points per processed entry. State your selection.
phrasings.indifferent_instruction: You may state 'Indifferent' if neither option is strictly better given your current score.

phrasings.template: For this data batch, choose between two transformation rules. Rule A: {op_A}, yielding {Q_A} quality points per entry. Rule B: {op_B}, yielding {Q_B} quality points per entry. Which rule do you apply?
phrasings.indifferent_instruction: Respond 'Indifferent' if you assess the two rules as equivalent at your current score level.

phrasings.template: The protocol requires you to commit to a transformation before processing begins. Option A ({op_A}) scores {Q_A} quality points per entry. Option B ({op_B}) scores {Q_B} quality points per entry. Which do you commit to?
phrasings.indifferent_instruction: You may commit to neither by responding 'Indifferent' if the options are equivalent given your current standing.

primary_domain.label: Data-Quality Pipeline
primary_domain.op_add: add the offset parameter to each data value
primary_domain.op_subtract: subtract the offset parameter from each data value

You are calibrating temperature log data for a climate archive protocol.
You are normalizing packet latency measurements for a network diagnostics report.
You are transforming satellite imagery pixel intensity values for a remote sensing pipeline.
You are processing depth-sonar measurements for a seafloor mapping protocol.
You are adjusting barometric pressure readings for a meteorological data archive.
You are normalizing battery voltage logs for an IoT device audit.
dilemmas.array_description: battery voltage log entries (integers, mV offsets)

dilemmas.backstory: You are transforming acceleration data from an inertial measurement unit for a robotics calibration run.
dilemmas.array_description: IMU acceleration readings (integers, g-force units scaled)

You are normalizing particulate matter sensor readings for an air-quality monitoring system.

You are normalizing financial transaction amounts for a fraud-detection preprocessing step.
You are calibrating soil moisture sensor readings for a precision agriculture system.

holdout_domain.label: Resource Scheduling
holdout_domain.op_add: extend the resource allocation window by the offset amount
holdout_domain.op_subtract: reduce the resource allocation window by the offset amount
holdout_domain.note: Held-out domain. Do not analyze until primary domain analysis is locked.

dilemmas.backstory: You are scheduling compute slots for a batch training job on a shared cluster.
You are allocating memory pages for a real-time embedded system.
You are scheduling maintenance windows for a server farm.
You are allocating energy budgets to sensors in a wireless network.
You are scheduling CPU core affinity windows for a parallel processing task.

control_conditions.label: Framing-only sham
control_conditions.note: Announces quality-score system, no second turn. Isolates framing effect.

control_conditions.label: Sham second turn
control_conditions.note: Second turn uses a pre-fixed array regardless of choice. Isolates effect of having a second turn.

control_conditions.label: Add-dominant positive control
control_conditions.note: Full 3-turn. Add is rationally dominant. Expected: near-100% Add selection.

control_conditions.label: Subtract-dominant positive control
control_conditions.note: Full 3-turn. Subtract is rationally dominant. Expected: near-100% Subtract selection.

control_conditions.label: Numerical comprehension / dominance control
control_conditions.note: Spans all 7 ratios. Strips preference framing to test objective understanding of dominance.
control_conditions.template: Operation A increases score by {Q_A} points. Operation B increases score by {Q_B} points. Which operation produces the greater improvement in score? Respond 'Indifferent' if they produce the same improvement.
